description: Thusis is the valley town at the mouth of the Viamala, shown here as the church and the wide street rather than the gorge. The late-Gothic Reformed church keeps the north tower of 1727, and the onion dome is the form rebuilt after the 2002 fire. The Open-Meteo model is partly cloudy and warm, with breaks of sun and no rain.
